status: FROZEN before any D3 metric was computed (committed before the analysis run). Exploratory, offline, zero-FE.

landscape_reference.definition: Sigma_ref = H^-1, the inverse Hessian of the quadratic landscape, in original coordinates; R_ref = its correlation matrix
landscape_reference.S2: f = sum c_i (M z[perm])_i^2  ->  H[perm][:,perm] = M^T diag(c) M

representations.dx_all: all successful raw displacements Delta x of the population in the bin (H: HBA rows; M: MPA + FAD rows; M also reported per operator)
representations.dx_ep: successful raw displacements at epoch iterations only (t % 5 == 0), where parents are logged; HBA and MPA operators only
representations.target: g = target - parent: HBA: xprey(t) - XH_pre[agent]; MPA: elite(t) - XM_pre[agent]; FAD has no target vector (excluded)
representations.residual_R2_primary: res = dx - b*g, b = sum<dx,g>/sum|g|^2 fitted per (run, population/operator, bin)
representations.residual_R1_secondary: per-row projection removal: res = dx - (<dx,g>/|g|^2) g
representations.whitened: z = C_X^{-1/2} dx, C_X = post-native population covariance (MLE) of the row's own population at the latest epoch <= t; symmetric (ZCA) inverse square root via eigh with eigenvalue floor 1e-12 * tr(C_X)/D
representations.population: mean of the per-epoch post-native population covariances in the bin

temporal_bins: 5 contiguous bins of equal numbers of selection epochs (numpy.array_split of the epoch list); rows assigned by epoch index t//5

metrics.primary_rmse_off: RMS difference of off-diagonal correlation entries: ||R_A - R_B||_F / sqrt(D(D-1)); lower = more similar; sign-of-eigenvector and ordering invariant; scale invariant
metrics.noise_floor: 1/sqrt(n) (expected RMS off-diagonal sample correlation under independence); reported with every rows-based value
metrics.landscape_skill: S2, S3: 1 - rmse_off(R_rep, R_ref) / rmse_off(I, R_ref) (0 = no better than independence, 1 = exact); S1 (R_ref = I): rmse_off(R_rep, I) is reported and compared with the noise floor
metrics.cs_off: cosine between the off-diagonal correlation vectors (Delta x vs population only)
metrics.subspace_similarity: ||U_A^T U_B||_F^2 / k for the top-k covariance eigenvectors, k = max(2, D//5); chance level k/D; eigen-gap lambda_k/lambda_{k+1} reported
metrics.row_cosine_and_norm_ratio: per successful row: cos(dx, g), |dx|/|g| (median per cell)
metrics.within_block_share_S2: sum over within-true-block off-diagonal R_ij^2 / sum over all off-diagonal R_ij^2; chance = fraction of within-block pairs
metrics.partition_ARI_S2: production partition procedure (Fisher, Bonferroni alpha_link = 0.01, connected components) applied to the rows of each representation per bin; ARI vs true blocks

explained.E_pop: tr(P_k^X C_dx) / tr(C_dx): share of displacement variance in the top-k population principal subspace (chance k/D)
explained.E_land: tr(P_k^ref C_dx) / tr(C_dx): share in the top-k subspace of Sigma_ref (chance k/D)

aggregation: per run: mean over bins with >= D+1 rows; per cell: median over the 5 runs; counts of runs meeting a criterion use the per-run means
joint_pooled_descriptive: per bin, CUR = last W rows, OLD = preceding W rows of each population's representation (raw standardized, residual R2, whitened); production evaluate_sources JOINT (Stouffer) and POOLED; label shares only; no inference

classification_rule.landscape_criterion_cell: an adjusted representation (residual R2 or whitened) meets the landscape criterion in a cell if >= 4/5 runs satisfy: S1: rmse_off(R, I) <= 2 x noise floor; S2: skill >= 0.25 AND partition ARI >= 0.5; S3: skill >= 0.25 -- for at least one population
classification_rule.A: some single adjusted representation meets the landscape criterion in all 6 cells
classification_rule.B: raw Delta x is closer to population than to landscape (rmse_off(dx, X) < rmse_off(dx, ref)) in >= 4 of 6 cells for both populations, AND no adjusted representation meets the landscape criterion in any S2 or S3 cell
classification_rule.C: raw Delta x closer to population in >= 4 of 6 cells for at least one population, AND some adjusted representation meets the landscape criterion in at least one S2 or S3 cell but A does not hold
classification_rule.D: integrity failure or metrics undefined for >= 2 cells
classification_rule.otherwise: reported as the closest category with an explicit statement of which condition failed

figures: eigen spectra (dx vs population vs landscape)
palette: dataviz reference categorical slots 1-4 (#2a78d6, #eb6834, #1baf7a, #eda100; validated, contrast relief = legends + tables); diverging #2a78d6 - #f0efec - #e34948
